description: WHEN TO USE: To check the status of a running or completed scan. REQUIRES: project_id and scan_id from lbm_run_scan or lbm_list_scans. RETURNS: Scan object with status (pending/running/completed/failed), progress, start/end times, and result count. NEXT STEP: When status="completed", call lbm_list_results to see monitoring results.
name: lbm_get_scan_status
